waypoints.name: Cascade Pass Trailhead (Cascade River Road end)
waypoints.directions: From SR-20 at Marblemount, keep straight where the highway turns left and you are on Cascade River Road. Follow it about 23 miles to its end at the Cascade Pass Trailhead lot, around 3,600 ft; the upper road is gravel. No parking pass is needed for day use, but a North Cascades National Park backcountry permit is required to camp on the route.

waypoints.name: Johannesburg Mountain Summit
waypoints.directions: From the lot, drop to and cross the Cascade River, cross the terminal moraine, and downclimb into the avalanche moat to gain the rock before the Cascade-Johannesburg couloir narrows. Climb the Northeast Rib through brush, heather and about 700 ft of good 5.6 rock to the bivy ledge near 7,100 ft, then the snow arete and headwall above, and scramble Class 3 along the summit ridge to the top.
